description: We're a tech-driven team with experience in cybersecurity, AI, and detection engineering. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we're tackling the MODIS & VIIRS Hot Spots challenge to turn satellite data into meaningful wildfire insights. Our goal is to build an intelligent monitoring platform that detects unusual patterns and visualizes fire activity. We're looking for passionate teammates skilled in Data Science, GIS, Machine Learning, Web Development, and UI/UX.
